output.reason: [ev-da7ff24b2c60] says only that Strimzi 0.46.0 adopted a new Kafka Connect health check endpoint. That is a change in how the operator runs health checks, but nothing says anything fails, is rejected or needs operator action. This change is also missing from the 0.46.0 upgrade notes, which list the steps operators must take (e.g. [ev-4c2676e4665a], [ev-87094cfdd770], [ev-17b3774eb9ee]). So a low-severity behavior-change (review, not mandatory work) is the strongest consequence the evidence supports, and the proposed statement does not over-claim.
